policies.description: Dispatch one reviewer invocation immediately for every observed head and let every invocation run to completion.
Composite CI baseline: reset a five-minute debounce on every head, cancel an obsolete running job, and reuse only an already-completed identical whole-diff hash.
Wait for a 15-minute stable head, cancel obsolete work, reuse only a completed identical whole diff, and flush the current head when the provider emits a final-head signal.

simulation_contract.completion_order_at_equal_timestamp: review completion, then timer dispatch, then external trace event
simulation_contract.final_head_signal: The v0 retrospective replay maps the public merge event to an explicit final-head signal and drains any resulting run. A deployable pre-merge integration needs a required check or merge-queue signal.
simulation_contract.review_duration: Per-case median public CodeRabbit review-submission lag, replayed as a deterministic fixed duration for all three policies.
